title: Transformed Samplers with Variance Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2610.10870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods are the standard tool for computing expectations under complex probability distributions. Control variates reduce the variance of the resulting estimates, but a good control variate requires solving the Poisson equation of the sampler, which rarely admits a closed-form solution. Exact solutions are available when the sampler's kernel has a known spectral decomposition on a simple reference density. In our work, we extend these solutions to general targets through a learned change of variables. A bijection, such as a normalizing flow, is trained so that the target becomes close to the reference in a latent space, and we show that Markov kernels and their Poisson solutions are transformed by any bijection. Running such samplers in the latent space then yields explicit control variates, and the estimator is consistent under mild tail conditions on the map and target. Importance sampling (IS) from th

translated_title: 具有方差缩减的变换采样器
translated_abstract: 马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法是在复杂概率分布下计算期望的标准工具。控制变量可以降低估计结果的方差，但一个好的控制变量需要求解采样器的泊松方程，而该方程很少存在闭式解。当采样器的核在某个简单参考密度上具有已知的谱分解时，可以获得精确解。在我们的工作中，我们通过学习到的变量变换将这些解推广到一般的目标分布。我们训练一个双射（例如归一化流），使目标分布在潜空间中接近参考分布，并证明了马尔可夫核及其泊松解可以被任意双射所变换。在潜空间中运行此类采样器即可得到显式的控制变量，并且在该映射和目标分布的温和尾部条件下，估计量具有一致性。基于……的重要性采样（IS）
tldr: 该论文提出通过学习双射（如归一化流）将MCMC采样器变换到潜空间，把简单参考分布上的泊松方程精确解推广到一般目标分布，从而获得显式控制变量以实现方差缩减。
en_tdlr: This paper extends exact Poisson equation solutions from simple reference densities to general targets via learned bijective transformations (e.g., normalizing flows), yielding explicit control variates that reduce the variance of MCMC estimates.
